name: Ferienhaus Isabella
beschreibung: The Ferienhaus Isabella is located in the center of Ebbs, a quiet village in the Tiroler Unterland near Kufstein. The accommodation is suitable for families and offers a comfortable holiday apartment with a kitchen, living area, and balcony. Within a few minutes, guests can reach shopping facilities, inns, and hiking trails in the surrounding area. The region at the foot of the Kaiserberge invites guests to take walks and excursions into the local recreation area. Parking spaces are available.
